snapshot.comment:
Qualified partial inventory for supplying 1 kg of iridium metal at the producer gate. Uses pooled PGM mining, concentration, smelting and refining purchased-energy data for 2015-2019, extended to iridium by economic allocation. Includes delivered electricity, fuel supply and combustion, a residual to match reported corporate direct SO2, four North-Concentrator flotation-chemical manufacturing proxies and additional purchased potable water. Background: ecoinvent 3.12 cut-off. ZA is a geographical proxy for the operator pool, which also includes Zimbabwe. This is independently constructed foreground data, not an ecoinvent dataset or a certified complete iridium inventory. Metal purity, commercial form and Ir-specific recovery are unspecified.

Boundary: intended cradle-to-producer-gate proxy. The corporate pool includes purchases/toll refining; full upstream mining for purchased concentrate is not demonstrated. No downstream catalyst manufacture, electrolyser use or consumer iridium quantity is included. Final-refinery chemical make-up, remaining direct emissions, mineral-resource extraction, recovery losses, land, complete waste treatment and complete water withdrawals/returns are unresolved, not zero.

Allocation: pooled energy and environmental quantities multiplied by mean iridium price (924.4 USD/troy ounce, 29720.150128 USD/kg) divided by the published annual basket value (5018995769 USD). Iridium mass cancels in this per-kg economic formulation. No substitution/recycling credits are added. Coproduct chrome and other outputs remain outside the inherited seven-product basket. Input fuel shares retain the source assumptions; native useful-heat services are converted to a fuel-energy basis and combustion counted once.

Flotation scenario: commercial-product dose interpretation; North feed share 0.688888888889, inferred from later 9.3/(9.3+4.2) Mtpa capacities, not measured 2015-2019 North throughput. Combined historic Mogalakwena feed also includes some Baobab toll treatment. The North recipe is not assigned to the whole company's ore. Active-fraction assumptions: SIBX 95%, Senkol3 40%, Senfroth516 100%, Norilose6064 60%. Remaining commercial carriers/impurities and reagent environmental fate are unmodelled.

Chemical manufacturing proxies: sodium ethyl xanthate for SIBX; generic organophosphorus-compound average for the dithiophosphate promoter; short-chain polyether polyols for the PPG400 frother; pure CMC powder for active CMC. These are upstream burden proxies, not proof of chemical, grade or toxicity equivalence. The generic organophosphorus average is particularly weak.

Water: purchased potable supply is reduced by softened water already in the coal service, assuming that boiler feed belongs to the corporate potable budget. No net-consumption result is established. SO2: the foreground residual assumes the corporate direct total includes utility combustion; upstream supplier emissions remain included separately. The residual uses a stack compartment. Other emissions are not calibrated to corporate totals.

Temporal coverage: primary company quantities 2015-2019; flotation source signed 2020; capacity split from 2023; reagent formulation preprint 2024. Native background technologies have their own reference periods. Uncertainty is represented by documented dose/share/purity scenarios, not a measured probability distribution or completeness bounds. No LCIA was performed.

Version 1.0.0 scientific package. Exchange amounts are static. Assumption changes require regeneration and a new reviewed scientific version. The production amount is a functional-unit normalization, not annual production.

exchanges.comment: Qualified residual to match the pooled 2015-2019 reported direct SO2 total under economic allocation after subtracting the native energy services' direct SO2 across air compartments. Assumes the corporate reporting scope includes this utility combustion. Remaining emission assigned to smelter/refinery stacks. Not measured Ir-specific emissions; upstream emissions remain in suppliers once.
exchanges.name: Sulfur dioxide

exchanges.comment: SIBX active mass represented by sodium ethyl xanthate at 1:1 kg. Different alkyl chain; functional manufacturing proxy, not chemical equivalence or evidence for field emissions or equivalent environmental impacts. Reagent dose basis: commercial; North-only capacity-share engineering scenario. Amounts are generated from the separately recorded model parameters.
exchanges.name: market for sodium ethyl xanthate

exchanges.comment: Senkol3 active sodium diethyl dithiophosphate represented at 1:1 kg by a generic organophosphorus manufacturing average. Native average includes insecticide-related substances; a weak production proxy, not actual Senkol3 chemistry, impurity, release, pesticide use or toxicity. Reagent dose basis: commercial; North-only capacity-share engineering scenario. Amounts are generated from the separately recorded model parameters.
exchanges.name: market for organophosphorus-compound, unspecified

exchanges.comment: Senfroth516 PPG400 mixture represented at 1:1 kg by native short-chain polyether polyols (<1000 g/mol). Native polyurethane feedstock is not a verified frother formulation; manufacture only, not field-release chemistry. Reagent dose basis: commercial; North-only capacity-share engineering scenario. Amounts are generated from the separately recorded model parameters.
exchanges.name: market for polyether polyols, short chain

exchanges.comment: Norilose6064 represented by pure CMC powder at active mass. Commercial-grade impurities/carriers remain unmodelled and explicitly quantified. Reagent dose basis: commercial; North-only capacity-share engineering scenario. Amounts are generated from the separately recorded model parameters.
exchanges.name: market for carboxymethyl cellulose, powder

exchanges.comment: Corporate purchased potable water less native coal-service softened-water input, assuming that embedded boiler feed originates from the reported potable budget and 1 kg water corresponds to 1 litre. Native softening and its upstream burdens remain included once. This does not close the site's water/return balance or establish net water consumption. Reagent dose basis: commercial; North-only capacity-share engineering scenario. Amounts are generated from the separately recorded model parameters.
exchanges.name: market for tap water
